subject: Information Theory
title: CRC Codes
description: Learn CRC Codes in one minute.

hook.text: Ethernet checks every frame with a CRC-32. In 40 years, the detection failure rate is virtually zero.

buildup.text: CRC (cyclic redundancy check) treats data as a polynomial and computes its remainder after division.

discovery.text: CRC-32 detects all single-bit, double-bit, and odd-count errors. It catches bursts up to 32 bits long.

twist.text: CRCs detect errors but can't correct them. A failed CRC triggers retransmission, not repair.

climax.text: CRCs are in Ethernet, USB, Bluetooth, ZIP files, and PNG images. They're the internet's sanity check.

punchline.text: Polynomial division catches corruption. Pure algebra.

quiz.question: What mathematical operation does a CRC use?
